{{Quote|You two look like you could use a hand. What did you do to irk the sky cops?|Jaina Solo to Luke and Mara Skywalker|<ref name="EVII:R" />}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force interceptor''' was an [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] utilized [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] as early as the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CorCWorld" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|Anti-Jedi sentiment]] reached such a peak in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] that it forced Chief of State [[Borsk Fey'lya]] to order the arrest of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]. When they tried to flee [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', they were pursued by four CSF interceptors and fought a brief battle. However, no one was killed in the incident and the Jedi managed to escape with the intervention of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="EVII:R" />

During the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], the CSF interceptors along with their military counterparts in the [[Coruscant Planetary Defense Force]] were almost completely wiped out.<ref name="SBS" />
